summary: Bounded string copy: copies up to 63 characters from a2 into the buffer at this+112 via sub_587DD0, writes a NUL terminator at v2[63] (field this+0xAF), and returns the copy result.

operations.description: Set v2 = this + 112, the destination buffer pointer.
Call sub_587DD0(this + 112, a2, 63) to copy at most 63 characters from a2 into the destination buffer.
Write a NUL terminator (0) at v2[63], the field at this+0xAF.

unresolved: The destination buffer start (this + 112) is evidenced only by the source literal 112, not by a field record; only the terminator field this+0xAF is evidenced.
Owning object type, source-call semantics of sub_587DD0, and the meaning of the copy length 63 are unknown.
